integrity: The lower bound is certified by an explicit anti-triangular layer matrix of rank ell-1 whose blow-up has exactly the graph pattern. A matching zero forcing set leaves one white representative in each valuation layer and forces them successively.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite commutative chain rings.
The one-vertex case q=2 and ell=2 is an explicit exceptional boundary.
The minimum-rank statement is over real symmetric matrices.
All minimum zero forcing sets are not classified.
A later adjacency-spectrum paper was available only at abstract/bibliographic level in the accessible path.
title: Zero forcing and real minimum rank of finite chain-ring zero-divisor graphs
